title: "Examples from the help file"
subtitle: "The examples at the end of help totalme, run in full"

The examples from the end of the [help file](help.html), in order, on the
GSS extract used in Mize and Han (2025).

## Single model

```{.stata-run}
. use https://tdmize.github.io/data/data/cda_gss, clear
(cda_gss.dta |  GSS 1972-2021 CDA - Categorical Data Analysis | date created 2023)

.
```

A nominal independent variable (ME inequalities are calculated on each
outcome):

```{.stata-run}
. totalme race4
Model (totalme_mod1) is:
     mlogit healthR i.race4 c.age i.woman
Nominal IV(s):
     race4

Total ME Estimates (N = 51084)

                         |   Estimate   Std. err.           z       P>|z| 
-------------------------+-----------------------------------------------
race4                    |                                               
          total ME Ineq. |      0.087       0.005      18.901       0.000 

. totalme race4, unweighted

     mlogit healthR i.race4 c.age i.woman
Nominal IV(s):
     race4

Total ME Estimates (N = 51084)

                         |   Estimate   Std. err.           z       P>|z| 
-------------------------+-----------------------------------------------
race4                    |
```

## Bootstrap example

Shown rather than run; 1,000 replications of an `mlogit` take a while.

```stata
capture program drop boot_tot

program define boot_tot, rclass
    mlogit healthR i.race4 c.age i.woman, base(1)
    totalme race4
    return scalar w_tot = r(tmwm11)
end

bootstrap w_tot=r(w_tot), reps(1000): boot_tot
```
